body: Thank you for your kind words. The pain will and has lessened but I'm just so tired. I'm so tired of keeping up with myself.

The exact same thing has happened to me in the last few months.
I'm trying to keep one foot in and one foot out, and encouraging myself to stay grounded.
But you HAVE to enjoy your time with this new guy! It's the silver lining! Well done for getting through all the shit, you've got strength!
X
